title: Bilateral waveform analysis of gait biomechanics presurgery to 12 months following ACL reconstruction compared to controls
paper_bibliography: Büttner, C., Lisee, C., Bjornsen, E., Buck, A., Favoreto, N., Creighton, A., Kamath, G., Spang, J., Franz, J. R., Blackburn, T., & Pietrosimone, B. (2025). Bilateral waveform analysis of gait biomechanics presurgery to 12 months following ACL reconstruction compared to controls. Journal of Orthopaedic Research, 43, 322–336. https://doi.org/10.1002/jor.26001

bibliographic_info.authors: Christin Büttner; Caroline Lisee; Elizabeth Bjornsen; Ashley Buck; Natália Favoreto; Alexander Creighton; Ganesh Kamath; Jeffrey Spang; Jason R. Franz; Troy Blackburn; Brian Pietrosimone

purpose.summary: 이 연구의 목적은 일차 편측 ACLR 전과 수술 후 2, 4, 6, 12개월에 ACLR 사지, 비침범 사지, 매칭된 비손상 대조군 사이의 보행 생체역학을 비교하는 것이다.
purpose.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study was to compare gait biomechanics between limbs and to matched uninjured controls (i.e., sex, age, and body mass index) preoperatively and at 2, 4, 6, and 12 months following primary unilateral anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR).

purpose.summary: 저자들은 vGRF, KFA, KEM, KAM을 전체 입각기 파형으로 비교하여 기존 연구의 한계를 극복하려 했다.
purpose.evidence_quote: This study aimed to overcome these specific limitations by comparing key gait biomechanics (i.e., vGRF, KFA, KEM, KAM) throughout the stance phase of gait between the a) ACLR and uninvolved limbs, b) ACLR and matched control limbs, and c) uninvolved and matched control limbs at preop, as well as 2, 4, 6, and 12 months post‐ACLR follow‐up timepoints.

purpose.summary: 가설은 시간이 지나면서 양 사지가 더 대칭적이 되지만, 두 사지 모두 대조군보다 덜 동적인 파형을 보이고 ACLR 사지의 차이가 더 클 것이라는 내용이다.
purpose.evidence_quote: We hypothesized that gait biomechanics of the ACLR and uninvolved limbs would become more symmetrical over time, however, both limbs would demonstrate less dynamic and more sustained waveforms compared with controls at all timepoints, with the ACLR limb demonstrating larger differences from controls than the uninvolved limb.

design_and_participants.summary: 연구 설계는 일차 편측 ACL 손상자와 비손상 매칭 대조군을 포함한 전향적 종단 코호트 및 중첩 사례-대조 비교이다.
design_and_participants.evidence_quote: We conducted a prospective, longitudinal cohort study with nested case‐control comparisons of gait biomechanics (i.e., vGRF, KFA, KEM, and KAM) in individuals with primary unilateral ACL injury and uninjured matched controls.

design_and_participants.summary: ACLR 대상자는 만 16-35세의 일차 편측 ACL 손상자로, ACLR 예정자를 단일 학술 의료기관 기반 정형외과에서 모집했다.
design_and_participants.evidence_quote: We recruited individuals with a primary unilateral ACL injury between the ages of 16 and 35 years who were planning to undergo ACLR from a single academic health system‐based orthopedic practice.

design_and_participants.summary: 대조군은 ACLR 참가자의 성별, 기저 연령, 기저 BMI에 맞추어 매칭되었다.
design_and_participants.evidence_quote: Uninjured controls were matched based on sex (female/male), baseline age (±2 years), and baseline body mass index (BMI±4kg/m2 ).

design_and_participants.summary: 분석에는 ACL 손상 모집자 62명 중 적어도 한 시점에서 보행 생체역학 자료가 있는 58명이 포함되었고, 시점별 ACLR 표본수는 preop 50명, 2개월 54명, 4개월 55명, 6개월 53명, 12개월 50명이었다.
design_and_participants.evidence_quote: Gait biomechanical data were available for at least one timepoint for a total of 58 out of 62 recruited participants with ACL injury (Figure 1). As a result, we analyzed datasets for the following number of participants at each timepoint in the ACLR group: preop n =50; 2 months: n =54; 4 months: n=55; 6 months: n =53; 12 months: n =50 (Supplement 1; Table S1.1).

methods.summary: 보행 생체역학은 10대 카메라 3D 모션캡처, 3개 힘판, 29개 반사 마커로 6m 보행로에서 맨발의 자기선택 보행속도로 수집되었다.
methods.evidence_quote: Gait biomechanics were collected as described in previous work29–31 using a 10‐camera 3D motion capture system (Vicon Bonita; Vicon Motion Systems Ltd, Oxford, UK) and three staggered and embedded force plates (FP406010; Bertec Corporation, Columbus, OH, USA) in a 6m walkway.
methods.locator: PDF p.4, Methods, Biomechanical gait assessment

methods.summary: 각 참가자는 평균 습관 보행속도의 ±5% 안에서 힘판을 완전 접촉한 성공 시행 5개를 양 사지에서 수집했다.
methods.evidence_quote: Next, 5 successful trials of gait biomechanics were collected from both limbs at the habitual walking speed.
methods.locator: PDF p.4, Methods, Biomechanical gait assessment

methods.summary: 자료는 Visual3D와 Matlab 사용자 정의 스크립트로 처리되었고, 10 Hz 차단 주파수의 4차 저역통과 Butterworth 필터가 사용되었다.
methods.evidence_quote: Data were processed using custom scripts in Visual3D (version 2020) and Matlab (version R2022b) and filtered using a recursive fourth‐order low‐pass Butterworth filter with a cut‐off frequency of 10Hz.
methods.locator: PDF p.4, Methods, Biomechanical gait assessment

methods.summary: 생체역학 결과는 입각기 0-100%의 101개 지점으로 시간 정규화되었고, 입각기는 vGRF 20 N 기준의 heel strike부터 toe-off까지로 정의되었다.
methods.evidence_quote: Biomechanical outcomes were time‐normalized to 101 data points (0–100%) throughout the stance phase, which was defined as heel strike (vGRF>20N) to toe‐off (vGRF<20N).
methods.locator: PDF p.4, Methods, Biomechanical gait assessment

methods.summary: 주요 파형 비교는 시점별로 기능적 혼합효과모형을 적용하여 ACLR-비침범, ACLR-대조, 비침범-대조를 비교했다.
methods.evidence_quote: Separate functional mixed effects models were compiled at each timepoint for gait biomechanical outcomes (i.e., vGRF, KFA, KEM, KAM) to compare differences between the (a) ACLR and uninvolved limbs, (b) ACLR limb and control limb, and (c) uninvolved limb and control limb.
methods.locator: PDF p.4, Methods, Gait biomechanical analysis

methods.summary: 통계적 유의성은 평균 차이의 95% 신뢰구간이 0을 포함하지 않는 파형 구간으로 정의했다.
methods.evidence_quote: Statistically significant differences between waveforms were defined as areas in which the 95% confidence interval of the mean difference did not include zero.
methods.locator: PDF p.5, Methods, Gait biomechanical analysis

methods.summary: 보행속도가 ACLR군과 대조군 사이에서 모든 시점에 달랐기 때문에, 저자들은 동일한 파형 분석을 습관 보행속도를 통계적으로 통제한 상태에서도 수행했다.
methods.evidence_quote: Since gait speed differed at all timepoints between the ACLR and uninjured controls and is linked to changes in biomechanical outcomes34 and KOA development following ACLR,35,36 we also conducted the same waveform analysis as described while statistically controlling for the average habitual walking speed of each participant at each timepoint (i.e., preop, 2, 4, 6, and 12 months) relative to the average walking speed of all participants at the same timepoint.29,32
methods.locator: PDF p.5, Methods, Gait biomechanical analysis

key_results.summary: ACLR군은 모든 5개 시점에서 대조군보다 유의하게 느린 속도로 걸었고, 연령과 BMI 차이는 없었다.
key_results.evidence_quote: The ACLR group walked at significantly slower speeds at all 5 timepoints (p<0.001) compared with controls. No differences in age (p =0.95) or BMI (p=0.57) were found between groups (Table 1).

key_results.summary: ACLR 사지는 대조군보다 모든 시점에서 초기 입각기 vGRF가 작고 중간 입각기 vGRF가 컸다.
key_results.evidence_quote: The ACLR limb demonstrated lesser vGRF during early stance and greater vGRF during midstance at all timepoints compared with controls (preop: 6–28%, 39–63%; 2 months: 6–30%, 39–63%; 4 months: 8–30%, 43–62%; 6 months: 10–29%, 44–61%; 12 months: 11–28%, 47–59%).
key_results.locator: PDF p.5, Results, Vertical ground reaction force

key_results.summary: ACLR 사지는 2, 4, 6, 12개월에 대조군보다 입각기 첫 50%에서 KFA가 작고 중후기 입각기에서 KFA가 컸다.
key_results.evidence_quote: smaller KFA during the first 50% of stance and greater KFA during mid‐ to late stance was observed at 2 (3‐42%, 50‐86%), 4 (3‐43%, 52‐86%), 6 (1‐46%, 59‐84%), and 12 months (1‐43%, 56‐92%) post‐ACLR in the ACLR limb compared with controls.
key_results.locator: PDF p.6, Results, Knee flexion angle

key_results.summary: ACLR 사지는 비침범 사지보다 모든 시점에서 초기 입각기 KEM이 작고 중후기 입각기 KFM이 작았다.
key_results.evidence_quote: The ACLR limb demonstrated lesser KEM during early stance as well as a lesser knee flexion moment (KFM) during mid‐to late stance at all timepoints compared with the uninvolved limb (preop: 10‐24%, 45‐84%; 2 months: 8‐34%, 53‐82%; 4 months: 9‐36%, 61‐80%; 6 months: 9‐37%, 68‐73%; 12 months: 13‐26%, 72‐76%; Figures 4A‐J; Table 5).
key_results.locator: PDF p.7, Results, Knee extension moment

key_results.summary: ACLR 사지는 모든 시점에서 대조군보다 초기 입각기 KAM이 작았다.
key_results.evidence_quote: The ACLR limb demonstrated lesser KAM during early stance at all time points (preop: 14–30%; 2 months: 12–35%; 4 months: 12–29%; 6 months: 13–22%, 12 months: 13–26%) compared with controls (Figures 5A‐E, 5K‐O; Table 6).
key_results.locator: PDF p.7, Results, Knee adduction moment

key_results.summary: 보행속도 보정 후에도 전체적으로 비보정 분석과 유사한 결과가 나타났지만, 일부 vGRF, KFA, KEM, KAM 차이는 줄거나 사라졌다.
key_results.evidence_quote: Overall, the analysis with gait speed adjustment demonstrated similar outcomes as those of the non‐adjusted analysis.
key_results.locator: PDF pp.7-8, Results, Differences in gait biomechanical outcomes with gait speed adjustment

author_conclusion.summary: 저자들은 ACLR군에서 preop부터 12개월까지 vGRF, KFA, KEM, KAM의 양측 보행 생체역학이 대조군과 다르다고 결론 내렸다.
author_conclusion.evidence_quote: Overall, gait biomechanics, collected at habitual walking speeds, are changed bilaterally between preoperative and 12 months post‐ACLR in vGRF, KFA, KEM, and KAM compared with controls.

author_conclusion.summary: 사지 대칭성은 시간이 지나며 좋아졌지만, ACLR 사지는 비침범 사지보다 대조군과의 차이가 지속적으로 더 컸다.
author_conclusion.evidence_quote: Though the ACLR and uninvolved limbs become more symmetrical over time, the ACLR limb persistently demonstrates greater differences in gait biomechanics compared to controls than the uninvolved limb.

author_conclusion.summary: 저자들은 ACLR 후 보행 생체역학이 대조군보다 덜 동적이며, 장기적 무릎 관절 건강을 위해 초기 양측 정밀 중재가 필요하다고 제시했다.
author_conclusion.evidence_quote: Our results indicate that early bilateral precision interventions are needed to normalize gait, which could improve long‐term knee joint health outcomes following ACLR.

author_conclusion.summary: 임상적 의의로, ACLR 후 보행 재훈련은 편측 수술 후에도 양측 접근을 고려해야 한다고 제안했다.
author_conclusion.evidence_quote: Further, gait retraining interventions need to consider bilateral approaches to normalize gait following unilateral ACLR.

limitations.summary: 대부분의 대상자가 골-슬개건-골 자가이식을 받은 일차 편측 ACL 손상자였기 때문에 다른 이식 유형, 다중 ACL 손상/수술, ACL 결핍자에게 일반화하기 어렵다.
limitations.evidence_quote: We only included individuals with unilateral ACL injury of which most (93%) received a bone‐patellar‐bone tendon autograft. Therefore, our results are not generalizable to individuals who received different graft types, had multiple ACL injuries/surgeries, or are ACL‐deficient.

We also did not control the rehabilitation following injury/surgery, however, including individuals who received general postoperative care makes the results of our study more generalizable to the current standard of care.

limitations.summary: 추적은 수술 후 12개월까지였기 때문에 양측 이상 보행 생체역학이 12개월 이후에도 지속되는지는 판단할 수 없다.
limitations.evidence_quote: We assessed gait biomechanics up until 12 months post‐ACLR and can therefore not determine whether aberrant bilateral gait biomechanics persist beyond 12 months post‐ACLR.

limitations.summary: 16세 미만 또는 35세 초과 ACLR 대상자에게 결과를 일반화하기 어렵다.
limitations.evidence_quote: Since age can impact gait biomechanical outcomes following ACLR,32 our results may not be generalizable to individuals with ACLR that are younger than 16 or older than 35 years old.

limitations.summary: ACL 손상 전 ACLR군과 대조군 사이의 자연적 보행 생체역학 및 보행속도 차이는 알 수 없다.
limitations.evidence_quote: Furthermore, it is unknown whether there were natural differences in gait biomechanics and gait speed between the ACLR group and controls before ACL injury.

reviewer_thoughts.summary: 이 연구의 강점은 ACLR 사지뿐 아니라 비침범 사지와 매칭 대조군을 함께 비교하여 편측 ACLR 후 양측 변화를 분리해 해석하려 한 점이다.
reviewer_thoughts.evidence_quote: Separate functional mixed effects models were compiled at each timepoint for gait biomechanical outcomes (i.e., vGRF, KFA, KEM, KAM) to compare differences between the (a) ACLR and uninvolved limbs, (b) ACLR limb and control limb, and (c) uninvolved limb and control limb.
reviewer_thoughts.locator: PDF p.4, Methods, Gait biomechanical analysis

reviewer_thoughts.summary: 파형 전체를 분석했다는 점은 피크값 중심 분석보다 입각기 중간 또는 말기의 차이를 포착하는 데 유리하다.
reviewer_thoughts.evidence_quote: Therefore, utilizing waveform analyses to evaluate the entire stance phase instead of just discrete points may provide greater insights into how gait differs between groups.

reviewer_thoughts.summary: 대조군은 단일 세션만 측정되었으므로, ACLR군의 시간 변화와 대조군의 시간 안정성을 동일한 종단 구조로 비교한 것은 아니다.
reviewer_thoughts.evidence_quote: Gait biomechanics were collected at habitual walking speed during preop and at 2, 4, 6, and 12 months post‐ACLR in individuals with ACL injury and during a single data collection session for controls.

reviewer_thoughts.summary: 보행속도 보정 전후 결과를 모두 제시한 것은 타당하지만, 저자 스스로 느린 보행속도가 일부 차이의 기전일 수 있다고 해석했으므로 보정 결과와 비보정 결과를 구분해 인용해야 한다.
reviewer_thoughts.evidence_quote: Overall, our analyses with gait speed adjustment suggest that slower walking speed may have been a mechanism contributing to some of the differences between limbs that were found in our analyses without adjusting for gait speed.

prior_research_problems.summary: 기존 체계적 문헌고찰과 메타분석은 ACLR 초기 시점의 비정상 보행 생체역학을 포괄적으로 특성화하는 데 지식 공백이 있다고 지적했다.
prior_research_problems.evidence_quote: Previous systematic reviews and meta‐analyses have highlighted key knowledge gaps negatively impacting the ability to comprehensively characterize aberrant gait biomechanics at early timepoints following ACLR.15–17

prior_research_problems.summary: 기존 연구는 preop부터 12개월까지의 초기 종단 자료가 부족했다.
prior_research_problems.evidence_quote: Specifically, previous studies lack early longitudinal data between preoperative timepoints (preop; i.e., following ACL injury but before ACLR) and 12 months post‐ACLR that may be most relevant for guiding supervised rehabilitation of aberrant gait biomechanics before returning to unrestricted physical activity.

prior_research_problems.summary: 기존 연구는 ACLR 사지 변화를 비침범 사지와 매칭 비손상 대조군 모두에 체계적으로 비교하지 않는 경우가 많았다.
prior_research_problems.evidence_quote: Further, most studies do not systematically compare the biomechanical changes exhibited in the ACLR limb to both the contralateral, uninjured limb and matched‐uninjured controls.

prior_research_problems.summary: 기존 연구는 보행의 피크 크기 같은 이산 특징에 주로 초점을 두었다.
prior_research_problems.evidence_quote: Finally, previous studies primarily focused on changes in discrete features of gait, such as peak magnitudes (e.g., peak vGRF, peak KFA).

study_solution_and_contribution.summary: 본 연구는 preop부터 12개월까지 ACLR 사지, 비침범 사지, 비손상 대조군을 모두 포함한 첫 포괄적 보행 생체역학 파형 분석이라고 저자들이 제시했다.
study_solution_and_contribution.evidence_quote: While this is the first comprehensive waveform analysis of gait biomechanics from preop to 12 months post‐ACLR including the ACLR limb, uninvolved limb, and uninjured controls, there are limitations of our study that should be considered for future research.

study_solution_and_contribution.summary: 연구는 비침범 사지도 대조군 기준으로 12개월에 정상화되지 않았으므로 편측 ACLR 후 양측 재활이 필요하다는 임상적 함의를 제시했다.
study_solution_and_contribution.evidence_quote: the uninvolved limb still does not exhibit normalized gait biomechanics, as defined by our control group, by the 12‐month timepoint. Therefore, gait rehabilitation following unilateral ACLR should include bilateral intervention.

study_solution_and_contribution.summary: 연구는 vGRF 중간 입각기와 KFA의 초기-말기 입각기 등 피크값 외 구간의 차이를 보여, 초기 50% 피크만 보는 해석의 한계를 지적했다.
study_solution_and_contribution.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrate that differences between limbs and controls may also exist during midstance in vGRF as well as early to late stance in KFA.

referenceable_claims.original_quote: Individuals who sustain an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury are at high risk for developing knee osteoarthritis (KOA), with a third of individuals developing KOA in the first decade following injury despite undergoing surgical ACL reconstruction (ACLR) and therapeutic rehabilitation.1
referenceable_claims.korean_translation: ACL 손상을 입은 사람은 KOA 발생 위험이 높으며, ACLR과 치료적 재활을 받더라도 손상 후 첫 10년 안에 약 3분의 1이 KOA를 겪는다는 주장이다.
referenceable_claims.cited_reference: 1. Luc B, Gribble PA, Pietrosimone BG. Osteoarthritis prevalence following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a systematic review and numbers‐needed‐to‐treat analysis. J Athl Train. 2014;49(6):806‐819.
referenceable_claims.usage_note: ACLR 후 KOA 위험의 배경 근거로 사용할 수 있다. 이 문장은 원 논문이 아니라 체계적 문헌고찰을 인용한 2차 인용이므로 정확한 유병률 해석은 Luc et al. 원문 확인이 필요하다.

referenceable_claims.topic: ACLR 후 보행 생체역학과 관절조직/증상 관련성
referenceable_claims.original_quote: Aberrant gait biomechanical outcomes, including reduced surgical limb vertical ground reaction force (vGRF), knee flexion angle (KFA), knee extension moment (KEM), and knee adduction moment (KAM) have been associated with deleterious joint tissue metabolism,2,3 altered tibiofemoral cartilage composition,4–9 radiographic joint changes,10 and worse knee‐related symptoms in patients with ACLR.11,12
referenceable_claims.korean_translation: 수술 사지의 vGRF, KFA, KEM, KAM 감소 같은 비정상 보행 생체역학은 ACLR 환자에서 불리한 관절조직 대사, 경골대퇴 연골 조성 변화, 방사선학적 관절 변화, 나쁜 무릎 관련 증상과 연관되었다는 주장이다.
referenceable_claims.cited_reference:
2. Pietrosimone B, Loeser RF, Blackburn JT, et al. Biochemical markers of cartilage metabolism are associated with walking biomechanics 6‐months following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction. J Orthop Res. 2017;35(10):2288‐2297.
3. Luc‐Harkey BA, Franz J, Hackney AC, et al. Immediate biochemical changes after gait biofeedback in individuals with anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction. J Athl Train. 2020;55(10):1106‐1115.

referenceable_claims.topic: 본 연구의 양측 보행 변화 결과
referenceable_claims.original_quote: Overall, gait biomechanics, collected at habitual walking speeds, are changed bilaterally between preoperative and 12 months post‐ACLR in vGRF, KFA, KEM, and KAM compared with controls.

referenceable_claims.original_quote: Our results indicate that early bilateral precision interventions are needed to normalize gait, which could improve long‐term knee joint health outcomes following ACLR.
